idea-plugin.name: ZK
idea-plugin.description:
A ZK framework plugin for IntelliJ IDEA that helps developers work with the ZK Java Web Framework. The plugin provides powerful, schema-aware code completion and validation to accelerate development.

Enhance your ZK development experience with MVVM data binding support, featuring intelligent code completion and seamless navigation. Effortlessly jump from ZUL binding expressions to ViewModel properties, command methods, and template URIs. Benefit from deep type propagation for chained properties, smart command name suggestions, and automatic scope variable completion.

Features:
  • Layout Preview
    • A side-by-side layout preview for .zul files — see how a page lays out while you edit, refreshed on save
    • Rendered through your project's own ZK jars in a separate helper process; your application never runs (ViewModels, Composers, and converters are never instantiated), so bound values appear as placeholders rather than real data
    • A first-paint layout view, not a live application preview
  • ZUL File Support
    • ZUL code completion for ZK components, attributes, and events
    • ZUL to class declaration navigation
    • ZUL syntax check and validation
  • ZK Configuration File Support
    • ZK configuration file (zk.xml) code completion and validation
    • Language addon configuration file (lang-addon.xml) code completion and validation
    • Note: To enable code completion, either use the default filenames (zk.xml, lang-addon.xml) or add the correct namespace to your custom-named XML file.
  • MVVM Development Support
    • Intelligent code completion for MVVM annotations (@init, @load, @bind, @save, @command, etc.)
    • Advanced property completion with deep type propagation for chained paths (e.g., vm.user.name)
    • Context-aware suggestions for command names and scope variables
    • Seamless navigation from ZUL to Java ViewModel properties, command methods, and template URIs
    • Intelligent navigation between matching ZUL tags
  • Project Creation
    • Provide ZK Maven archetypes for creating ZK projects
  • Live Templates
    • Built-in ZK snippet templates: grid, listbox, tree, ns, jspatch — just type the abbreviation and press Tab
  • Feedback Menu
    • a feedback menu under the Help menu for feedback and documentation
See ZK Developer's Reference / Intellij IDEA ZK Plugin for details.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3

  • [bug] #70 Layout Preview: images, stylesheets and scripts from your own webapp folder never load — the preview now serves regular files out of your src/main/webapp. Before this, a page with <image src="/img/logo.png"/> previewed as an empty box even though the file was right there, and a page's own CSS and JavaScript silently never applied, so the pane showed half-styled output with nothing to indicate why. Serving is confined to the webapp folder: WEB-INF, META-INF, dot-files and any path escaping the folder are refused, directories are never listed, and assets are never cached so an edit shows up on the next save.
  • [bug] #71 Layout Preview: a .zul path with no file behind it looked like a page that rendered blank — the preview pane now shows which path was not found and which webapp folder it was looked for in, instead of a silent blank pane. Before this, the render server answered such a request as if it had succeeded, with an empty page and no message anywhere, so a preview of the wrong path was indistinguishable from a page that really does render to nothing.

1.0.2

  • [bug] #69 Layout Preview: an <include> whose src is a data binding fails to load ("No dispatcher available to include …") — a bound src is no longer written into the page as raw expression text. When the binding names a constant path (src="@load('~./page.zul')") the page is now included for real; when the path comes from the ViewModel (which never runs in the preview) the include simply contributes nothing, instead of leaving an error box in the middle of the layout.

1.0.1

  • [bug] #66 Cannot open a .zul file on IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 (NoClassDefFoundError: org/cef/handler/CefRequestHandler) — IntelliJ 2026.2 moved JCEF out of the IDE runtime into the bundled "Web Browser (JCEF)" plugin, whose classes are visible only to plugins that declare it. The plugin now declares that dependency, so the Layout Preview renders again.
  • [bug] A missing or disabled JCEF no longer costs more than the preview: the .zul editor always opens, and the preview pane explains which JCEF is missing and how to restore it — including the new "enable the bundled Web Browser (JCEF) plugin" case, and a browser that is present but fails to start.
  • [bug] #67 Layout Preview: a <zscript> naming one of the project's own classes fails to render (Class or variable not found) — the preview now hands the render process your module's compiled output, so a page whose <zscript>, use="…" or custom EL function names one of your own classes renders instead of failing. ViewModels and Composers are still never instantiated, so bound values remain placeholders.

1.0.0

  • [feature] Layout Preview — a side-by-side preview for .zul files, refreshed on save. Rendered through your project's own ZK jars in an isolated helper process, so no server and no deploy are needed. Covers MVVM binding placeholders, model-bound data components (grid, listbox, tree), <apply>/<include>, ZK add-ons, and Spring Boot jar projects.
  • [feature] A source view in the preview pane, alongside the rendered layout.
  • [feature] A formatted render-error page with a collapsible stack trace and a one-click "Report on GitHub" hand-off that states what the report contains before sending it.
  • [feature] JCEF-unavailable diagnosis with an open-in-external-browser fallback.

0.7.3

  • #64 Add support for IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 — remove the until-build upper bound so the plugin stays compatible with current and future IntelliJ IDEA releases without a per-version update

0.7.2

  • [bug] #61 MVVM binding chain stops resolving past an inherited generic getter (generic type arguments not substituted)
